calendar.sources.title: Fetched by the server
calendar.sources.footer: Calendars from a link or a CalDAV account. The server fetches them every hour, and the phone shows them in Dagen.
calendar.sources.info_label: About calendars fetched by the server
calendar.sources.info: Fetch Now on a link's page fetches it at once. Each phone gets the events in a calendar of its own, which the kid can't change; nothing more than 60 days old is sent. For a CalDAV account use an app password, not your usual password: iCloud makes one at account.apple.com, Fastmail and Nextcloud in their password and security settings. Google works only as a link: the calendar's secret address in iCal format. Nothing from the phone is written back.
calendar.sources.info_privacy: The server keeps the events (titles, descriptions, places, times) while the calendar is here, and sends them only to the phones that have it. Links and app passwords are stored encrypted and never shown again; a password goes only to the hosts on its account's page, and if the server answers from another host, fetching stops until you test again. An account is shared by every phone here, each getting only the calendars switched on on its page; one no phone uses is deleted, password and all, a day after it was last used. The events the kid adds on the phone stay on the phone.
calendar.sources.no_key: Calendars from links and accounts are off: the server has no key to store them encrypted. Check the server log (MUSIC_SECRET_KEY).

devices.code.replaces: The phone that uses this code takes over, and the one connected now is cut off.
devices.code.footer: On {name}: Vibb One's Settings › Enroll with code.
devices.code.info: Set the Server URL there first, and the Tailscale key if the phone uses Tailscale. The code is shown only here.
devices.qr.title: Connect {name}
devices.qr.replaces: A phone that uses a new QR code or setup code takes over, and the one connected now is cut off.
devices.qr.missing_checksum: No QR code without the launcher's signing checksum: set LAUNCHER_SIGNATURE_CHECKSUM in the server's .env and restart it (DEPLOY.md).
devices.qr.missing_url.before: No server address yet: set it in
devices.qr.missing_url.after: , or type it on the phone.
devices.qr.keep_open: Keep this page open until the phone has connected. Reloading it makes a new code.
devices.qr.password_hint: Only in the QR code, never stored.
devices.qr.footer: On the phone's welcome screen, tap 6 times in one spot, then scan.
devices.qr.info: It works once, for {minutes} minutes. GrapheneOS has no 6-tap setup: make Vibb One the device owner with adb, then scan from its Settings › "Scan setup QR".
devices.qr.paused_sub: Too many wrong codes were tried this hour. The QR code works now.
devices.qr.code_footer: You type it in Vibb One's settings on the phone.
devices.qr.code_info: It works once, for {minutes} minutes, and replaces any QR code made before.
device.about.connection_footer: Online means the phone has a live link to this server. Changes reach it within seconds.
device.about.connection_info: Without it, changes wait for the phone's own check-in, every 30 minutes.
device.about.crashes_footer: Vibb One restarts by itself after a crash. A report holds only where in the code it happened.
device.advanced.backup_on_sub: The phone turns it off at its next sync (Vibb One's Settings › Sync now). If it stays on, something on the phone keeps turning it on: report it.
device.advanced.restrictions_footer: A pause or the Parent PIN doesn't lift these.
device.advanced.restrictions_info: Block screenshots also stops screen recording and casting, and recent-apps previews go blank. Locate needs Keep location on. A reset from the recovery menu can't be blocked.
device.advanced.debugging_footer: Turn it off before you work on the phone with a computer.
device.advanced.debugging_info: While it is blocked, a computer can't repair the phone: if Vibb One breaks and can't reach this server, only a reset gets it back.
device.advanced.safe_boot_footer: Turned on with the first Child PIN: safe mode skips the lock.
device.advanced.safe_boot_info: Safe mode starts the phone without Vibb One, unfiltered (the restrictions above still apply). It repairs nothing, so blocking it costs nothing once Vibb One works on this phone.
device.advanced.backup_info: When on, Android may copy app data, calls, SMS and settings to Google. Vibb One keeps it off; there is no switch for it.
device.advanced.block_screens_footer: Turn it off only if something breaks.
device.advanced.block_screens_info: Screens of apps that aren't allowed never open, even from an allowed app. The Play Store stays paused, except in install mode and at night for updates.
device.advanced.fence_sub: Hides Android's home screen while Vibb One updates.
device.advanced.notification_filter_sub: Removes notifications that open blocked screens.
device.advanced.boot_cover_sub: Shows the Vibb logo while the phone starts.
device.advanced.updates_footer: Vibb One installs its own updates at night, with the screen off.
device.advanced.updates_info: Test Update fence and Boot cover (from the next restart) on this phone model first. The filter keeps allowed apps, calls, alarms and emergency alerts, and never reads a notification's text.
device.advanced.snoozed.one: {count} snoozed for an hour: it kept coming back
device.advanced.snoozed.other: {count} snoozed for an hour: it kept coming back
device.advanced.access_removed_sub: It can't reach this server until it connects again with a new setup code. It keeps its last settings.
device.advanced.disconnect_confirm: Disconnect {name}? It can't reach this server until it connects again with a new setup code. It keeps its last settings.
device.advanced.connection_footer: A new code reconnects the phone after a reset, replacing its current connection.
device.advanced.remove_confirm: Remove {name}? Its settings and history are deleted, and it can't reach this server any more. This can't be undone.
device.apps.not_reported: The phone hasn't reported its apps yet.
device.apps.footer: Turning an app off hides it, and uninstalls it where possible.
device.apps.info: Only an allowed app's keyboard or accessibility service can be turned on in the phone's settings. Your child can rename only the apps you haven't named.
device.apps.downloads_footer: Turn it off when an app is needed now.
device.apps.downloads_info: Vibb One's own updates wait up to 3 days for Wi-Fi, then take any network. Nothing downloads while roaming.
common.saved_online: Saved. The phone gets it within seconds when online.
device.bedtime.title: Bedtime
device.bedtime.corrupt_sub: {parts}, so they show empty here and are saved as you see them: set them again, then Save - or remove the bedtime.
device.bedtime.nights_footer: From evening to morning, on the phone's clock. Fri-Sat are the nights before Saturday and Sunday. Leave a row empty for no bedtime on those nights.
device.bedtime.calls_footer: The phone is locked during bedtime. Emergency calls always work.
device.bedtime.remove_confirm: Remove the bedtime? {name}'s phone is no longer locked at night.
device.calls.footer: While managed, only the contacts below can call or text. Emergency numbers always work.
device.calls.info: Dial ##004# on the phone once, so rejected calls don't go to voicemail. Don't add the voicemail number or 1881 and 1880: they connect any number. SMS off also hides the Messages app.
device.calls.remove_confirm: Remove {contact} from {name}'s phone? Their calls are then blocked.
device.calls.none: No contacts yet. While calls are managed, only emergency numbers work.
device.calls.number_hint: Without a country code, +{code} is used (Settings › Phone Setup).
device.calls.contacts_footer: A contact's name and photo (up to 10 MB) are shared by every phone with that number.
device.filter.label: Web filter
device.filter.footer_spotify: Blocks the lists and domains below, except Spotify's while this phone plays Spotify.
device.filter.footer: Blocks the lists and domains below on this phone.
device.filter.info.before: It works on any network, and your child can't turn it off. The lists for every phone are in
device.filter.spotify_hosts.before: Spotify's hosts are allowed on this phone while it plays Spotify, for every app on it (its
device.filter.spotify_global: Not applied on {name} for that reason, from Settings › Web Filter: {domains}.
device.filter.spotify_override: Not applied while this phone plays Spotify
device.filter.block_label: Domain to block on this phone
device.filter.allow_label: Domain to allow on this phone
device.filter.not_a_domain: That isn't a domain name, like example.com. Nothing was added.
device.filter.doh_allowed: {host} is a secure-DNS server and stays blocked.
device.filter.allowed_footer: Let through even when a list blocks it - not the secure-DNS servers built into Vibb One, which stay blocked.
device.filter.log_footer.one: Kept {count} day. Turning it off deletes this phone's log.
device.filter.log_footer.other: Kept {count} days. Turning it off deletes this phone's log.
device.home.layout_label: Language, apps per row and clock
device.home.layout_footer: The language of Vibb One's own screens on the phone. The clock format is the whole phone's: the status bar and Vibb One's clocks show the same.
device.home.wallpapers_footer.before: Your child picks from these on the phone. Add photos in
device.home.quick_footer: Shown when your child swipes left on the home screen.
device.home.quick_info: Touch sounds and vibration need the "Modify system settings" permission the clock format uses - grant it first, or your child sees them but can't change them.
device.lock.parent_first: Set a Parent PIN first: it opens the lock if the Child PIN is forgotten.
device.lock.child_pin_hint: 4 to 6 digits; 4 is easiest for a child.
device.lock.lock_test: Test phase: Android's lock will replace Vibb One's
device.lock.reveal_hint: The one you sign in here with. The PIN shows on this page only, for a minute; three wrong passwords sign you out.
device.lock.remove_child_confirm: Remove {name}'s Child PIN? The phone then opens without a code.
device.lock.footer_android: Android's lock: the PIN pad, and a fingerprint if you add one.
device.lock.footer_own: Locks the phone when the screen turns off.
device.lock.child_info_android: After a restart the phone can't be located, rung or erased, and alarms may not ring, until the Child PIN is typed. The Parent PIN doesn't open this lock: use Show Child PIN above.
device.lock.child_info_own: After 5 wrong PINs the phone waits 30 s, then longer; your Parent PIN ("Parent code" on the lock) always opens it. It doesn't encrypt the phone's data, and some bank apps won't work with it.
device.lock.no_parent_pin_sub: Without one, nothing can be opened or lifted on the phone itself. If this server is lost, only a reset gets the phone back.
device.lock.easy_sub: It is all one digit, a run like 123456, or a common PIN. A child who guesses it can lift every restriction.
device.lock.used_offline_sub: The time lock was lifted with it since the phone's last check-in.
device.lock.parent_pin_hint: 6 to 10 digits, not the Child PIN. 8 or more are much harder to crack; birthdays and years are easy to guess.
device.lock.remove_instead_child: Remove it instead (not while a Child PIN is set)
device.lock.parent_footer: Opens the phone's settings and lifts limits, even offline.
device.lock.parent_info: Locked out after wrong tries, or your child saw it? Save a new PIN here: the wait ends once the phone checks in.
device.lock.not_reported: Vibb One on this phone doesn't report this yet.
device.lock.screen_footer: With a Child PIN, the phone locks when the screen turns off.
device.lock.wake: Wake the screen for a notification
device.lock.wake_sub: For the apps on the lock below and missed calls
device.lock.lock_screen_footer: What the lock shows, anyone near the phone can see. A notification can be swiped away there, as on Android's own lock screen; nothing can be answered.
device.lock.unreadable: The apps couldn't be read. Check the server log.
device.lock.notifications_footer: Name only: the sender's name for chats, otherwise the app's name and how many. Full text: the message too, SMS login codes included, which anyone holding the phone can read. Missed calls always show.
device.time.bedtime_footer: Every night on the phone's clock.
device.time.everyone_footer: Off means the rule doesn't apply to {name}. A rule added later is on.
device.time.own_footer: They apply as well as everyone's rules that are on.
device.time.own_off_footer: A rule that is off was kept from when the phone followed everyone's rules: switch it on to use or change it.
device.time.budget_corrupt_sub: The phone gets an error instead of its rules until you save here again.
device.time.limit_footer: Minutes a day. Empty means no limit.
device.time.limit_off_footer: Off: {name} has the daily limit for everyone, set under Settings.
apps.perms.title: Permissions
apps.perms.camera_waiting: Camera off · waiting for the phone
apps.perms.camera_paused: Camera off · back on while restrictions are paused
apps.perms.update_note: Update Vibb One to manage apps' permissions
apps.perms.refused: This app's permissions can't be changed here.
apps.perms.full: This phone already has 200 apps with their camera off - turn some back on first.
apps.perms.camera_help: Off: {app} can't use the camera - a video call or a QR scan stops working. Turning it off closes {app} if it was allowed the camera.
apps.perms.how: On the phone: Settings (parent code) › Pause all restrictions › App access › {app}: {access}
apps.perms.how_alarm: On the phone: Settings (parent code) › Pause all restrictions › App access › {app}: {access}, then open {app} once while restrictions are paused
devices.access.unconfirmed: Nothing changed: tick the box first.
device.apps.refused_play: Installed from the Play Store, so it can't also come from the catalog. Uninstall that copy first.
device.apps.refused_changed: This app changed in the catalog since the page loaded. Try again.
error.save_failed_log: Couldn't save - nothing was changed. Check the server log.
error.read_phone: Couldn't read this phone - check the server log.
error.read_phones: Couldn't read the phones - check the server log.
error.create_device: Couldn't create the device - nothing was saved. Check the server log.
error.make_code: Couldn't make a code - nothing was changed. Check the server log.
error.not_an_app_name: Not an app this page can name.
error.not_an_app: Not an app - nothing was changed.
error.change_app: Couldn't change this app - check the server log.
error.out_of_date: This page is out of date - reload it.
error.send_failed: Couldn't send - nothing was queued. Check the server log.
error.unknown_launcher_ui: Unknown language, column count or clock format
error.save_photo: Couldn't save the photo - nothing was changed. Check the server log.
error.read_rules: Couldn't read the time rules - check the server log.
device.advanced.play.install_mode_sub: Install mode is on. Apps installed now stay hidden until you allow them.
device.advanced.play.updating_sub: The nightly update window is open while the screen is off.
device.advanced.play.restart_sub: After a Vibb One update, Android hasn't yet given Vibb One what it needs to {effects}.
device.advanced.play.not_suspendable: Play can't be paused on this phone
device.advanced.play.blocked_while_on: Play is blocked only while Block other apps' screens is on.
device.advanced.play.block_off: Block other apps' screens is off, so apps can open the Play Store.
device.about.network_none_sub: This server keeps the last request in memory, so it starts empty after a restart.
device.about.battery_sub: Changes may arrive late while the phone sleeps. To fix it on the phone: Vibb One's Settings › Pause all restrictions › Background connection › Allow, then end the pause. Or, with USB debugging allowed: adb shell dumpsys deviceidle whitelist +me.vibb.launcher
device.about.write_settings_sub: The touch sounds switches and the clock format need it.
device.write_settings_steps: To fix it on the phone: Vibb One's Settings › Pause all restrictions › Modify system settings › turn on Allow, then end the pause. Or, with USB debugging allowed: adb shell appops set me.vibb.launcher WRITE_SETTINGS allow (a debug build: me.vibb.launcher.debug).
device.about.title: About {name}
device.lock.wrong_last: Wrong password. One more wrong one signs you out.
device.lock.still_prev: Until the phone gets it, its PIN is still
device.lock.still_earlier: The phone still has an earlier PIN until it gets this one.
device.lock.changed_on_phone: The phone's PIN was changed on the phone: it isn't this one.
device.lock.not_stored: Not stored on this server. Set the Child PIN again to see it here.
device.lock.unreadable_key: Not readable on this server: it was kept with another server's key. Set the Child PIN again to see it here.
device.lock.no_key: This server can't read its key file, so it keeps no Child PIN to show. The server log says why.
device.home.no_notification_access_sub: Unread counts and the music card are off, and the lock screen shows only missed calls.
device.home.no_notification_access_fix: Android can't turn this on for Vibb One. With USB debugging allowed, run: adb shell cmd notification allow_listener me.vibb.launcher/com.kidslauncher.mdm.badges.BadgeListenerService (a debug build: me.vibb.launcher.debug; a launcher from before 2026-10-06: com.kidslauncher.mdm).
device.home.clock_not_applied_sub: The phone can't change its clock format yet.
device.home.clock_not_applied_fix: Vibb One needs Android's "Modify system settings" access, which a device owner can't grant.
device.apps.corrupt_sub: The phone keeps the last list it had, and switching apps here fails until it is fixed.
device.apps.corrupt_fix: The stored allowlist isn't valid JSON. Check the server log ("failed to build device policy"), or restore a backup.
settings.time_rules.gone_unsaved: That rule was deleted in the meantime, so nothing was saved.
settings.time_rules.rules_footer: Each rule is on for every phone until it is switched off on that phone's Time Rules page.
settings.time_rules.saved_off: Switched off for {name}, so not in use there.
device.time.too_old: Vibb One too old for time rules
device.time.too_old_sub: Until Vibb One updates, the phone keeps its old schedule and changes here don't reach it.
device.time.ledger_unreadable_sub: The phone counts today's screen time as used up.
device.time.incoming_not_blocked_sub: Calls aren't managed on this phone, so a rule without calls only stops calls out. Manage calls under Calls & Contacts.
device.bedtime.both_times: give both times, or leave both empty.
device.bedtime.noon: bedtime starts after noon and ends before noon.
device.bedtime.no_times: Give the times, or remove the bedtime.
device.bedtime.unreadable_both: Its nights and apps couldn't be read
device.bedtime.phone_gets_error: The phone gets an error instead of its rules.
device.calls.contact_gone: That contact was already removed, so nothing was saved.
device.calls.screening_sub: Vibb One is the phone app and hangs up calls that aren't allowed, but another app could screen incoming calls first. The phone can't tell which apps can. With USB debugging allowed: adb shell cmd role add-role-holder android.app.role.CALL_SCREENING {launcher}
device.calls.finding.emergency_call: The phone called an emergency number ({at}).
device.calls.finding.callback: Anyone can call this phone until {until}, so the emergency services can call back.
device.calls.finding.screen_failed: A call rang ({at}) but couldn't show over the lock, so your child may not have been able to answer.
device.calls.finding.screen_failed_fix: Please report this with Vibb One's version (About This Phone).
device.calls.finding.waiting_at: Its last report ({at}) is from before the change. Reload the page in a minute.
device.calls.finding.waiting: Its last report is from before the change. Reload the page in a minute.
device.calls.finding.unconfirmed: The phone hasn't reported since the change{changed}; it may be off or offline. The notes here are from its last report{report}.
device.calls.finding.dialer_not_allowed: The phone app isn't allowed under Apps, and calls aren't managed here. Turn it on under Apps, or turn on Manage calls and SMS.
device.calls.finding.messages_hidden: It isn't allowed under Apps, so texts can't be read or sent. Turn it on there.
device.calls.finding.stopped_screening: Vibb One on this phone stopped reporting that it screens calls; an older version may have been installed.
device.calls.finding.too_old: Vibb One on this phone is too old to screen calls. Update it.
device.calls.finding.fail_closed: Only emergency calls work until it gets good settings from this server.
device.calls.finding.not_phone_app: It can only call emergency numbers, and withheld numbers may ring through. On the phone, open the home screen and accept "Set as default phone app".
device.calls.finding.anyone_can_call: Incoming calls aren't screened, and only emergency calls go out. On the phone, open the home screen and accept "Set as default phone app".
device.calls.finding.no_redirection: Calls to numbers that aren't allowed are hung up only after they start.
device.calls.finding.no_redirection_fix: With USB debugging allowed: adb shell cmd role add-role-holder android.app.role.CALL_REDIRECTION {launcher}
device.calls.finding.call_log: Vibb One can't read the call log, so after an emergency call the emergency services may not get through. Check that Vibb One is the phone app.
device.calls.finding.restart_unreadable: The phone can't read its call rules for right after a restart: until it's unlocked once, only emergency calls work.
device.calls.finding.restart_unsaved: The phone couldn't save its call rules for right after a restart: until it's unlocked once, only emergency calls work. It tries again at every sync.
device.calls.finding.reported: Vibb One on the phone reported an error with the call rules.
device.calls.finding.sms_app_allowed: The phone keeps it hidden anyway, since it can chat over RCS. Turn it off under Apps.
device.calls.problem.emergency_call: Emergency call made from this phone
device.calls.problem.callback: Emergency services can call back now
device.calls.problem.screen_failed: A call may have rung unanswered
device.calls.problem.waiting: Waiting for the phone to confirm
device.calls.problem.fail_closed: Phone can't read its call rules
device.calls.problem.not_phone_app: Vibb One isn't the phone app
device.calls.problem.sms_app_allowed: Messages app allowed with SMS off
device.calls.name_refused: Give the contact a name (at most 60 characters).
device.calls.matrix_refused: A Matrix ID looks like @name:matrix.org. Nothing was saved.
devices.qr.ssid_long: Too long for a Wi-Fi network: shorten the name (at most 32 bytes; æ, ø and å count as two). Nothing was made.
devices.qr.password_short: A Wi-Fi password has at least 8 characters. Nothing was made.
devices.qr.password_long: A Wi-Fi password has at most 63 characters (or is a 64-digit key). Nothing was made.
devices.qr.ssid_missing: Add the network's name, or leave the password empty. Nothing was made.
devices.qr.too_long: The setup details are too long for a QR code - check the server address and Tailscale key in Settings › Phone Setup. Nothing was changed.
account.warning.login.one: {count} wrong two-factor code was entered before this sign-in. Whoever entered them knew your password - change it now.
account.warning.login.other: {count} wrong two-factor codes were entered before this sign-in. Whoever entered them knew your password - change it now.
account.warning.login_from.one: {count} wrong two-factor code was entered before this sign-in (from {ips}). Whoever entered them knew your password - change it now.
account.warning.login_from.other: {count} wrong two-factor codes were entered before this sign-in (from {ips}). Whoever entered them knew your password - change it now.
devices.warning.live_sub: Someone knows your password - change it
devices.warning.login: Wrong two-factor codes before this sign-in
devices.warning.login_sub: Someone knew your password - change it
devices.warning.push_may_not_show: Notifications may not be showing on {label}
devices.warning.push_unconfirmed: Pushed, but that device didn't confirm them
devices.warning.push_many.one: Notifications may not be showing on {count} device
devices.warning.push_many.other: Notifications may not be showing on {count} devices
device.about.policy.cache_corrupt_sub: The phone can't read its saved settings. It enforces the last app list it had (or nothing but Vibb One), and takes no changes until it gets good settings from this server.
device.about.policy.server_error_sub: This server answered with an error, so the phone keeps its last settings. Check the server log ("failed to build device policy").
device.about.policy.rejected_sub: The phone ignored the last settings from this server: they looked like a server falling back to defaults (no app list after it had one). Check the server log and version.
device.about.policy.decode_failed_sub: The phone couldn't read the last settings from this server; Vibb One and the server versions probably don't match. It keeps its current restrictions.
